queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Logitech Unifying Software %' AND publisher = 'Logitech';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Logitech Unifying Software %' AND publisher = 'Logitech' AND version_compare(version, '2.52.33') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'logitech unifying software.exe');
